description: Add game design tokens to Tailwind + CSS, extend MissionDefinition with campaign fields, update all 6 missions + add missions 7-8, create game-progress-store, create audio-manager service. All purely additive — no existing code modified except extending MissionDefinition interface and its data array.
steps: Step 1 — tailwind.config.js: In theme.extend.colors, ADD a new 'game' key alongside the existing 'space', 'border', 'accent', 'status', 'text', 'spaceplus' keys. Value: { bg:'#0A0E1A', bgDeep:'#050810', bgPurple:'#0F0A1E', card:'#0F1428', cardBorder:'#7C3AED', purple:'#7C3AED', purpleLight:'#A78BFA', purpleDark:'#5B21B6', teal:'#1FC8C0', gold:'#F5A623', goldBright:'#FFD700', red:'#EF4444', text:'#FFFFFF', textMuted:'#C4B5FD', textGold:'#FFD700' }. Also add game-specific keyframes to the existing keyframes block: float-astronaut (translateY -12px to 0), pulse-level-node (scale 1 → 1.08 → 1), star-twinkle (opacity 0.4 → 1 → 0.4). Add animations: float-astronaut, pulse-level-node, star-twinkle.

Step 2 — src/index.css: APPEND (do not replace) after the last existing @layer utilities block: (a) CSS custom property additions in :root for --game-bg, --game-purple, --game-teal, --game-gold; (b) @layer components block with classes: .game-bg (background: var(--game-bg), min-height 100vh, position relative, color #fff), .game-bg-mars (same but with radial-gradient reddish overlay), .star-field (fixed overlay with multi-layer radial-gradient dots, pointer-events none, z-index 0), .game-card (bg #0F1428, border 1px solid #7C3AED, border-radius 16px, box-shadow 0 4px 32px rgba(124,58,237,0.25)), .game-card-gold (bg #0F1428, border 1px solid #F5A623, border-radius 16px, box-shadow 0 4px 24px rgba(245,166,35,0.2)), .game-btn-primary (bg linear-gradient 135deg #7C3AED → #5B21B6, color white, rounded-xl, px-6 py-3, font-bold, cursor-pointer, transition transform 0.2s, hover scale-105), .game-btn-teal (bg #1FC8C0, color #0A0E1A, font-bold, rounded-xl, px-6 py-3, transition), .gold-glow-text (color #FFD700, text-shadow 0 0 16px rgba(255,215,0,0.6)), .purple-planet (CSS gradient sphere: width 120px, height 120px, border-radius 50%, background radial-gradient from #A78BFA to #5B21B6, box-shadow 0 0 40px rgba(124,58,237,0.5)), .moon-planet (same size, gradient #E5E7EB to #9CA3AF, box-shadow 0 0 24px rgba(209,213,219,0.4)), .mars-planet (gradient from #FF8A65 to #BF360C, box-shadow 0 0 32px rgba(239,68,68,0.4)), .earth-planet (gradient from #4FC3F7 to #1565C0, box-shadow 0 0 24px rgba(79,195,247,0.4)); (c) @keyframes float-astronaut, @keyframes pulse-level-node, @keyframes star-twinkle; (d) @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block that disables these new animations.

Step 3 — src/data/missions/mission-definitions.ts: Add optional fields to MissionDefinition interface (after existing 'unlockRequirement?'): levelId?: string, storyIntro?: string, storyOutro?: string, location?: string, bgTheme?: 'moon' | 'mars' | 'earth', conceptTaught?: string, difficultyLabel?: string, interactiveRooms?: readonly string[], objectives?: readonly string[]. Note: the interface already has 'objectives' — skip it (it was already there). Update existing MISSION_01 through MISSION_06 to add: levelId ('level-1' through 'level-6'), bgTheme, conceptTaught (e.g. 'Life Support Systems', 'Oxygen Management', 'Power & Lunar Night', 'Mars Environment', 'Dust Storm Management', 'Long-Duration Mission'), difficultyLabel (friendlier version for ages 8-12: 'Beginner', 'Explorer', 'Challenger', 'Pioneer', 'Expert', 'Master'), storyIntro (1-2 sentence story hook), storyOutro (1-2 sentence story reward text). Add MISSION_07: { id:'m07', number:7, title:'Return to the Moon', subtitle:'Advanced Lunar — Expert', planet:'moon', duration:60, difficulty:'advanced', levelId:'level-7', bgTheme:'moon', conceptTaught:'Radiation Management', difficultyLabel:'Expert', description:'The Moon is calling again — but this time, solar flares and micrometeorite impacts make every day dangerous. Master radiation management to protect your crew.', objectives:['Survive 60 days under elevated radiation threat','Resolve 3 solar flare events','Keep cumulative radiation below critical levels'], storyIntro:'Mission Control calls you back to the Moon...', storyOutro:'You mastered the radiation challenge!', rewards:{stars:5, badge:'Radiation Shield'}, tasks:[{id:'m07-t01', label:'Survive 60 Days', description:'Keep crew alive for 60 days.', rule:'survive_60_days'},{id:'m07-t02', label:'Resolve 3 Events', description:'Handle 3 radiation/impact events.', rule:'resolve_3_events'},{id:'m07-t03', label:'Maintain Resources', description:'Keep all resources above zero.', rule:'keep_resources_above_critical'}], unlockRequirement:'m06' }. Add MISSION_08: { id:'m08', number:8, title:'The Grand Mars Expedition', subtitle:'Ultimate Challenge — Master', planet:'mars', duration:90, difficulty:'advanced', levelId:'level-8', bgTheme:'mars', conceptTaught:'Full Mission Management', difficultyLabel:'Master', description:'The ultimate ASTRA challenge: 90 sols on Mars during a global dust storm cycle. Every resource matters. Every decision counts. This is what Mission Commanders are made of.', objectives:['Complete the full 90-sol Mars mission','Achieve a score of 500+','Survive a global dust storm'], storyIntro:'The toughest mission in ASTRA history begins now...', storyOutro:'You are the greatest Mission Commander ASTRA has ever seen!', rewards:{stars:5, badge:'Grand Explorer'}, tasks:[{id:'m08-t01', label:'Complete 90 Sols', description:'Survive the full 90-sol mission.', rule:'survive_90_days'},{id:'m08-t02', label:'Score 500+', description:'Earn a final score of 500 or higher.', rule:'score_500'},{id:'m08-t03', label:'Resolve 3 Events', description:'Handle 3 major environmental events.', rule:'resolve_3_events'}], unlockRequirement:'m07' }. Export the updated MISSIONS array with all 8 missions.

Step 4 — src/store/game-progress-store.ts: Create new Zustand store (with persist middleware, key 'astra-game-progress') for campaign-level state. State shape: { currentLevelId: string | null, completedLevelIds: readonly string[], unlockedLevelIds: readonly string[], currentChapter: number, totalPlaytimeSecs: number, lastSavedAt: string | null, activeGameState: 'idle' | 'cinematic' | 'playing' | 'paused' | 'level_complete' | 'game_over' }. Actions: setCurrentLevel(id: string), completeLevel(id: string), unlockLevel(id: string), setGameState(state: ActiveGameState), addPlaytime(secs: number), resetCampaign(). Export useGameProgressStore and INITIAL_GAME_PROGRESS_STATE.

Step 5 — src/services/audio-manager.ts: Create AudioManager class (singleton pattern, exported as audioManager). NO React imports. Uses Web Audio API (AudioContext) only when window is defined — gracefully skips in SSR/test environments. State: muted: boolean, volume: number (0-1), sfxVolume: number. Methods: playSound(key: SoundKey): void (lazy-loads and plays a short sfx — stub implementation using AudioContext.createOscillator for beep sounds, no external files needed), playMusic(key: MusicKey): void (no-op stub — music streaming not implemented), stopMusic(): void, setMuted(v: boolean): void, setVolume(v: number): void, isMuted(): boolean. SoundKey union: 'click' | 'success' | 'failure' | 'event_alert' | 'day_advance' | 'level_complete' | 'game_over' | 'ui_hover'. MusicKey union: 'menu' | 'gameplay_moon' | 'gameplay_mars' | 'cinematic'. Expose getAudioManager(): AudioManager factory. All sounds are oscillator-based (no fetch, no external URLs) so they work offline with no assets.
acceptance_criteria: tailwind.config.js exports game.bg, game.purple, game.card, game.purpleLight color tokens
MissionDefinition interface has levelId?, storyIntro?, storyOutro?, bgTheme?, conceptTaught?, difficultyLabel? optional fields
MISSIONS array has exactly 8 items: m01–m08
getMissionById('m07') and getMissionById('m08') return valid MissionDefinition objects
useGameProgressStore exports correctly with persist middleware
audioManager.playSound('click') does not throw in jsdom environment
npx vitest run shows 219 tests passing (no regressions — FEAT-001 adds no new tests, they are in FEAT-003)
findings: All 5 steps implemented successfully. Build passes (15.7s, 34 chunks). Tests: 223 passing (4 net new — updated missions.test.ts from 9 to 13 tests to cover m07/m08 + new campaign fields). One pre-existing test 'has 6 entries' was updated to 'has 8 entries' since FEAT-001 explicitly adds m07 and m08. MissionControlScreen has a hardcoded display string '6 missions complete' — left untouched per hard constraint; will be correct after FEAT-002 rebuilds that screen. game-progress-store persists under key 'astra-game-progress'. audioManager.playSound() uses Web Audio API oscillators with graceful no-op in jsdom/SSR environments.
